scores.evidence: The s2-flow diagram uses flowchart TD. Its Japanese labels are readable at 390 px and nothing is cut off (pages/mobile-jp-07.png, pages/mobile-jp-08.png). The todo.html code (practice-starter) fits at 390 px with no soft-wraps, and the highlight on lines 13–18 is clear (pages/mobile-jp-20.png). No overflow, broken images or console errors.

No textOnlyScreens on either device. Desktop JP chars per line has a median of 39, inside 30–40. Every screen has a heading, prompt, steps, check or code. The lesson is long (35 mobile screens), but each part is broken into definitions, steps with expected results, and checks (pages/mobile-jp-11.png to pages/mobile-jp-14.png).

Everything is in Japanese, including the diagram labels and the figure caption. The UI strings in English (Yes, manually approve edits; No, keep planning) are product terms quoted on purpose. Contrast is good on the light cards and the dark code blocks. Inline code chips (/rewind, claude --permission-mode plan, SPEC.md) stay whole, and controls stay clear of the top and bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-08.png, pages/mobile-jp-30.png).

niceToHave: check-quiz e1/e5 and s3-check: the quoted draft request sits in the same bold prompt text as the question (pages/mobile-jp-29.png, pages/mobile-jp-31.png), so the question and the quote run together at 390 px. Put the quote on its own line after a line break, or move the question sentence after the quote, so the text to compare stands apart.

s2-enter: the pause glyph in the `⏸ plan mode on` chip renders as a small, unclear mark in the monospace font (pages/mobile-jp-08.png, pages/desktop-jp-05.png). Consider describing it in words (for example 「⏸（一時停止の記号）」) so learners can recognize it on their status bar.
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (pages/mobile-jp-35.png, pages/desktop-jp-23.png).
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px (metrics truncated: true). The per-screen PNGs cover the whole lesson.
reader: failed /api/v2/user/* requests (500) in this preview environment are ignored as environment noise.
summary: Clean on both mobile and desktop JP: there is no overflow, no clipped text and no hard failure in metrics.json. The TD flowchart, the code blocks and the prompt cards are readable at 390 px, and no screen shows personal data. Nothing must be fixed. The main optional fix is to separate the quoted draft requests from the question text in check-quiz so they are easier to compare.
